test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the word from the options which is similar in meaning to the bracketed part given in the sentence below.

I suppose I was looking for (a work that would give me income) and that was going to be an adventure.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Occupation'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The bracketed phrase** "a work that would give me income"** is referring to an activity, particularly a regular and continuous one, that provides livelihood. 
 
• Out of the alternatives given, **"Occupation"** accurately captures the sense of the phrase. 
 
• Occupation refers to the regular job or profession that earns you a living.(पेशा)

Therefore, the** correct answer** is:** 'Occupation'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Activity:** This term refers to the state or quality of being involved in a particular task.(गतिविधि)
 
• **Calling: **While "calling" can refer to an occupation, particularly in the sense of a higher purpose or passion, it does not necessarily imply generating income. (बुलावा)
 
• **Pursuit:** This term is the act of pursuing, in general can refer to an occupation, hobby, or preoccupation, but the term lacks the specific implication of earning a livelihood. (अन्वेषण)
